pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Waving in Hotel Ballroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Alastor waves in the hotel ballroom in this printable coloring page, lifting one open hand while his microphone staff rests diagonally behind him beside tall curtained windows. Chandeliers hang above a curved staircase with repeated railings. His full-length pose leaves broad floor and trouser areas, with smaller window panes, bow-tie sections, and lamp shapes to color.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Running in Crimson Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Alastor runs through the Crimson Forest in this printable coloring page, lifting one leg behind him while holding his skull-topped staff horizontally across a winding path between trees. Exposed roots, scattered stones, and small leaves line the route. The coloring sheet includes long coat tails in motion and broad tree trunks beside finer branches and grasses.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Sitting in Dark Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Alastor sitting on a crate in a dark alley, with crossed legs, striped trousers, and one hand holding his microphone staff beside two trash cans. A fire-escape platform and ladder hang above the brick walls. The wooden crate panels and paving stones provide larger shapes around the smaller clothing stripes and metal handles.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Waving in Entertainment District Coloring Page
pages.description: Alastor waves in the entertainment district in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a crescent moon and stars among signs for an arcade, casino, and shows along the street. He carries his staff across his long coat, with wide antlers overhead. Small pedestrians, streetlamps, and marquee bulbs add details around the broad central figure.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Standing in Dark Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Alastor standing in a dark alley, holding his microphone staff beneath fire-escape balconies and ladders mounted above cracked brick walls on either side. Three trash cans and a tied bag sit behind him. The coloring sheet emphasizes his wide antlers, striped coat, and narrow legs among large paving slabs and scattered scraps.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Walking in Concert Hall Coloring Page
pages.description: Alastor walks through a concert hall in this printable coloring page, carrying his microphone staff diagonally as he strides past rows of empty seats toward the foreground. A closed stage curtain and arched balcony frame the hall. Repeated seat backs and floorboards add smaller sections around his long legs, pointed shoes, and flared coat tails.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Exploring in Dark Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Alastor exploring a dark alley, walking with his microphone staff along cobblestones toward a narrow passage between cracked walls, pipes, and a boarded window. An open box and lidded trash can sit near the path. His striped trousers and coat panels introduce long narrow shapes beside the masonry and paving details.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Pointing in Theater Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: Alastor points across a theater stage in this printable coloring page, extending one arm fully while carrying his microphone staff diagonally against a striped suit beneath draped curtains. A moon, stars, clouds, and city shapes decorate the backdrop. Broad curtain folds and floorboards surround the smaller antlered staff ornament, buttons, and bow tie on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Waving in Hotel Lobby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Alastor waving in the hotel lobby, raising his hand above branching antlers while holding his microphone staff across his striped coat near two tufted armchairs. A mantel clock, wall lamps, and chandelier furnish the room. The patterned rug and paired chairs add enclosed shapes around the tall central figure.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Exploring in Portal Chamber Coloring Page
pages.description: Alastor explores a portal chamber in this printable coloring page, gesturing toward a large swirling doorway edged with symbols while holding his microphone staff beside a cracked tiled floor. Gear-like wall decorations and arched openings frame the space. The portal's broad spiral bands contrast with smaller border markings, stone cracks, and the stripes of his coat.

pages.title: Hazbin Hotel Alastor Waving in Ancient Library Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Alastor waving in an ancient library, standing with his microphone staff beneath pointed stone arches beside shelves packed with books and a tall ladder. A small lamp rests on a table near the window. Repeated book spines and ladder rungs add fine sections around his broad coat panels and long trousers.
